experiment: Haiku 5.5 on T-1001, 12 runs per variant: how often tool-call markup leaks into a text field of submit_proposal

fields.runs_with_leak: runs where at least one proposal was refused for leaked markup
fields.other_rejections: proposals refused for other schema errors
fields.ended_with_proposal: runs that ended with an accepted proposal

conclusion: Field order is the cause: with the long likely_cause string before the evidence list, half the runs leaked; with evidence first, none did. Turning strict tool use off also stops leaks but trades them for many more schema errors. Effort makes no clear difference.
